posts.title: Global Military Assets: Production, Replacement and the Economics of Endurance
posts.description: Modern military power is often compared through inventories: ships, aircraft, tanks, missiles and drones. That is useful, but incomplete. A platform is valuable only when it can be produced, crewed, maintained, armed and replaced at the speed demanded by a conflict.

posts.title: Designing for agency
posts.description: As software moves from answering questions to taking action, design can no longer focus solely on interfaces. The central challenge becomes agency itself: who may act, under whose authority, within which constraints, and with what accountability.

posts.title: Design Governance OS
posts.description: An operating system to scale design quality in digital products and services — under real constraints, the minimum viable management system to keep decision integrity, delivery speed, and craft consistent across teams, markets, and high‑stakes domains.
